values.meaning: duration of bonus-armor penetration on crits
values.quote: For the next 15 seconds, the damage dealt by '''Yasuo's''' {{tip|critical strikes}} ignores {{sti|lethality|{{as|60% of the target's '''bonus''' armor}}}}.

mechanics.claim: The percentage bonus armor ignorance stacks additively with sources of percentage armor penetration.
mechanics.quote: The percentage {{as|'''bonus''' armor}} ignorance stacks additively with sources of {{as|percentage armor penetration}}.

mechanics.claim: Yasuo gains the bonus armor ignorance on-cast, before the damage is dealt.
Damage and forced movement removal both apply only when the airborne effect ends, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: ''Last Breath'' applies its damage and removes any forced movement{{bug|2}} on the targets when it ends

mechanics.claim: Spell shield does not prevent the cast or the knock up and damage, though it is still consumed.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will not prevent ''Last Breath'' from being cast and the target will be knocked up and dealt the damage.

mechanics.claim: Yasuo is locked out of all actions (attack, move, cast, items, consume, spells) while performing Last Breath.
